resources.string: Sends CarPlay turn-by-turn data to the factory ECARX navigation interface. Interface detection does not prove that the instrument cluster will display it. Connection choices apply on the next connection.
Show CarPlay navigation in the factory cluster
May take over the cluster navigation presentation. Changes apply on the next CarPlay connection.
This may replace the vehicle\'s own navigation prompts. Park safely before testing and verify that navigation clears after disconnecting.
Draws CarPlay lane directions for the ECARX lane interface. Requires a compatible instrument cluster and applies on the next connection.
Draws only semantic branches from RouteGuidance; it is not a factory junction image. Changes apply on the next connection.
Passes Apple maneuver IDs without ECARX mapping. Enable only when the target firmware requires it.
Choose who plays music. Factory Bluetooth keeps music and media keys in the vehicle while GeePlay continues navigation, Siri and call audio. Changes apply on the next connection.

With CarPlay music selected, temporarily disconnects only the car’s A2DP media profile to prevent play/pause contention. Calls and pairing stay available; A2DP is restored when CarPlay ends. Applies on the next connection.

GeePlay will automatically disconnect the car’s Bluetooth media profile while CarPlay runs. It does not turn Bluetooth off or disconnect calls, and restores media when CarPlay ends. Nearby devices permission is required.
OneOS media keys and the Flyme voice broadcast require an active CarPlay session. Factory Bluetooth disables interception. Profile changes apply immediately.
The OEM broadcasts have no verified sender permission. Another local app could imitate them, and the factory voice assistant may also respond.
Project stream 111 to the validated instrument display
Available only for an exact, vehicle-validated firmware and display profile. Changes apply on the next connection.
No vehicle-validated display profile matches this firmware. Direct projection remains disabled; export diagnostics to capture the display inventory.
Debug only. Select a non-default Android Presentation display to bypass the validated profile temporarily. The choice applies on the next CarPlay connection.
No non-default Android Presentation display is currently available. Reopen Settings after the target display appears.
This bypasses the vehicle-validated display profile and may cover original instrument content. Use only while parked. It applies on the next CarPlay connection.
Refresh Geely interfaces and retry cleanup
Hides upstream DiPlay controls that apply only to BYD or DiLink. Keep this enabled for GeePlay. Changes apply immediately and do not disable shared CarPlay features.
Reads approved vehicle data from EVCC 1.2 and sends supported battery, range, speed and gear information to the connected iPhone. Changes apply on the next connection.
Send battery and range to CarPlay
Shares traction-battery percentage, remaining range and charging state with the connected iPhone when EVCC provides a verified reading. Applies on the next connection.
Send vehicle speed to CarPlay positioning
Adds EVCC wheel speed and gear to location updates requested by the iPhone. Location sharing must also be enabled. Applies on the next connection.
Allow in-car video only while parked (experimental)
Uses the verified EVCC gear value and fails closed when it is missing or stale. Applies on the next connection.
Video is offered only while EVCC reports P. Unknown, stale or disconnected vehicle data disables playback. Use only where lawful.
Show EVCC tyre pressure and temperature (experimental)
Discovers read-only tyre descriptors for this firmware and shows fresh four-wheel readings in the side panel. Applies on the next connection.
GeePlay will inspect EVCC’s read-only property directory for tyre pressure and temperature. Unsupported or ambiguous wheel mappings remain hidden.
GeePlay will read the selected vehicle values from EVCC and share them with the connected iPhone. EVCC authorization is still required.
Explicit one-time actions only. Each write requires EVCC Shell authorization and a separate confirmation on the car screen; GeePlay never runs them automatically.
Allow hotspot system settings through EVCC
Add GeePlay to the doze allowlist through EVCC
Send this system action to EVCC?
EVCC requires shell.exec and shell.system_write authorization and will ask for a separate confirmation on the car screen. The action is not retried automatically.
Follow CarPlay music with cabin lighting
Uses only a vehicle-validated EVCC writable-property profile with validate, read-back and restore.
No vehicle-validated writable ambient-light profile matches this firmware. Writes remain disabled.
GeePlay will save the current lighting, validate every write, read it back and restore the original state when playback ends. EVCC property.write authorization is required.
